description: Validate a finished HyperCodeMotion composition and package it as a .hcmotion project file, the format HyperCodeMotion Studio opens. If the composition has problems, returns created: false with the errors to fix and stores nothing. On success, stores the file temporarily and returns an `open` link (opens the project in HyperCodeMotion Studio) and a `download` link; both expire 24 hours after creation. It does not render video or generate media.

json.description: The full composition (version, name, width, height, fps, duration, background, layers…), as an object or JSON-encoded string.

name: create_hcmotion
title: Create HyperCodeMotion project file
